textbookText: > The 150 MCQs above are kept intact. Below are the highest-yield traps, formula > cheats, series mnemonics, and boundary cards for stoichiometry, atomic structure, > states of matter, gas laws, and kinetic theory.

| # | Trap | Defense | |---|------|---------| | 1 | STP vs RTP gas volume | **STP (0°C, 1 atm): 22.4 L/mol. RTP (25°C, 1 atm): 24.0 L/mol.** Confusing the two is the #1 chem error. | | 2 | Kelvin vs °C in Charles / Gay-Lussac / van der Waals | **EVERY** T in equations is absolute (K). | | 3 | Confusing v_rms, v_avg, v_mp | v_rms=√(3RT/M) · v_avg=√(8RT/πM) · v_mp=√(2RT/M). **v_rms > v_avg > v_mp** always. | | 4 | Inverting Graham's-law ratio | r₁/r₂ = √(M₂/M₁): the lighter gas (smaller M) is faster. | | 5 | R vs k confusion | R = 8.314 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ (molar) · k = 1.38×10⁻²³ J K⁻¹ (per particle). R = Nₐ·k. | | 6 | Missing molar mass in v_rms | M must be in **kg/mol** (divide g/mol by 1000). | | 7 | Rydberg sign | 1/λ = R(1/n₁² − 1/n₂²) with n₂ > n₁ (always positive). | | 8 | Limiting vs excess reagent | Convert ALL reactants to **moles**, compare with the stoichiometric mole ratio, then pick the smaller. Mass comparison alone is wrong. | | 9 | Percent yield direction | %yield = (actual/theoretical)×100 — actual ≤ theoretical, so result ≤ 100%. | | 10 | Latent heat sign | Fusion and vaporization **absorb** heat; freezing and condensation **release**. Phase change ⇒ temperature constant. |
